night_start.name: {name}
night_start.text: *Back in my room, I lie down on the bed. The cherry-blossom scent clinging to my uniform shirt settles into the blankets.*

night_msg_seo_3.name: Seoyeon
night_msg_seo_3.text: *Next time I'll at least have drinks waiting*

night_msg_seo_5.name: {name}
night_msg_seo_5.text: *She sent 'On the house' as a separate message. Deliberately.*

night_msg_yuna_1.name: Yuna
night_msg_yuna_1.text: *It was nice having you sit quietly with me today*

night_msg_yuna_3.name: {name}
night_msg_yuna_3.text: *While I reread “I'll save your seat,” the screen dims on its own.*

night_msg_dain_3.name: Dain
night_msg_dain_3.text: *Still annoyed about that bread money. Seriously.*

night_msg_dain_4.name: {name}
night_msg_dain_4.text: *All three lines arrive almost at once. There's already a “lol” waiting in the reply box.*

night_hidden_check.name: {name}
night_hidden_check.text: *Buried under the messenger notifications — there's something else.*

night_hidden_homeroom_1.name: {name}
night_hidden_homeroom_1.text: *There's a post from the homeroom teacher on the school app. 'Class 3-2 Notice: Bring math supplies for 1st period tomorrow. — And the transfer student only needs to keep settling in okay.'*

night_hidden_homeroom_2.name: {name}
night_hidden_homeroom_2.text: *I read the notice one more time, then set the phone face down. My reflection flickers across the dark screen.*

night_hidden_nurse_1.name: {name}
night_hidden_nurse_1.text: *A notification pops up from the school's health app. 'Nurse's office record: Transfer student — mild dizziness. Drink plenty of water today and don't skip breakfast. If the symptoms return, visit the nurse's office.'*

night_hidden_nurse_2.name: {name}
night_hidden_nurse_2.text: *After reading the last reminder, I fill the water bottle beside my bed.*

night_late_transition.name: {name}
night_late_transition.text: *Just as I'm about to fall asleep, my phone buzzes again. Eleven at night. Who is it?*

night_seo_late_2.name: Seoyeon
night_seo_late_2.text: *If you don't show up, I'll come find you*

night_seo_late_3.name: {name}
night_seo_late_3.text: *When I set the phone down, tomorrow's arrival time remains on the lock screen.*

night_yuna_late_1.name: Yuna
night_yuna_late_1.text: *A gray bubble reads “This message was deleted.”*

night_yuna_late_2.name: {name}
night_yuna_late_2.text: *The typing indicator appears, then vanishes, but no new message arrives.*

night_yuna_late_3.name: {name}
night_yuna_late_3.text: *I open and close the reply box until the screen goes dark in sleep mode.*

night_yuna_late_4.name: {name}
night_yuna_late_4.text: *Only my thumbprint remains on the black screen.*

night_dain_late_4.name: {name}
night_dain_late_4.text: *I've already typed 'I'm in' into the reply box.*

night_dain_late_4_b.name: {name}
night_dain_late_4_b.text: *A string of emojis trails below Dain's message. Every single one is different.*

night_end_1.name: {name}
night_end_1.text: *I set the phone down and stare at the ceiling. The cherry blossom scent is still on my uniform.*

night_end_3.name: {name}
night_end_3.text: *The names I saved today remain on my lock screen. Even after turning off the display, my finger reaches for the power button once more.*
